strategy.name: Inside Bar & Pin Bar
strategy.summary: Trade clearly defined pin bars and inside-bar breaks (or fakeys) at key levels.

rules.text: Pin bar: wick ≥ 2/3 of the range, body ≤ 1/3 in the top (bull) / bottom (bear) third, at a key level.
rules.checklistQuestion: Did the pin bar meet the 2/3 wick rule at a key level?

rules.text: Inside bar: high < previous high AND low > previous low.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was it a true inside bar?

rules.text: Buy stop 2 pips above the pin/mother bar high (sell stop below for shorts).
rules.checklistQuestion: Was the entry 2 pips beyond the bar?

rules.text: Stop 2–5 pips beyond the pin tail or mother bar low/high.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was the stop beyond the tail?

rules.text: Target 2R–3.5R at the next structure level.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was the planned R:R between 2 and 3.5?

rules.text: Ignore pin bars shorter than 0.8 × ATR(14) or not at a key level.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was the pin bar at least 0.8 × ATR?
